newsitem.title: USA: Guess? in European joint venture.
newsitem.headline: Guess? in European joint venture.

text.p: Guess? Inc said Tuesday that it has signed a letter of intent to form Maco Apparel S.r.l., a joint venture in Europe with the Fingen Group.

Under a licensing agreement, the joint venture will manufacture and sell GUESS jeanswear in Western Europe and some parts of Eastern Europe. It will also purchase certain GUESS operations in Italy, the company said.
The company added that Maco will retain all existing GUESS Italian operations and assume all current customer orders for GUESS Europe.
The transaction is expected to close during the summer of 1997. No further details were provided.
Fingen is a manufacturer and distributor of apparel based in Florence, Italy.
